thread.title: Every Dow stock falls premarket, led by Boeing

title: Every Dow stock falls premarket, led by Boeing
text:
9:14 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
All 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.62% are declining in premarket trade Thursday, with Boeing Co. BA, -4.92% shares pacing the losses, as Dow futures YMM8, -2.55% fall 311 points ahead of the open. Boeing's stock was shedding 2.0%; the $6.65 price decline would shave about 46 points off the Dow's price. Among some of the other bigger decliners, shares of Travelers Companies Inc. TRV, -1.65% gave up 1.6%, Chevron Corp. CVX, -2.63% shed 1.5%, Intel Corp. INTC, -1.12% lost 1.4%, Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -2.57% slid 1.3% and American Express Co. AXP, -3.34% fell 1.4%. The most active stock was Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.97% which lost 1.1%. Quote References
